## Fixes

- **Real DNS answers for node servers:** Enabled node server domains now use real IPv4 and IPv6 DNS answers before the general FakeIP fallback. Explicit DNS Hosts overrides remain supported.
- **Accurate node ping paths:** Resolved node addresses are included in the node bypass rules. Ordinary clients can ping real node server addresses without TUN interception; ICMP to other destinations continues to follow the existing routing policy.
- **Device policies take priority:** Source-based device rules now run before node and process bypasses, including for DNS and ICMP. When device policies are active, node addresses are not placed in global TUN destination exclusions, preventing protected devices from escaping their assigned policy.
- **Fresh address exclusions:** Each configuration generation resolves enabled node domains once, shares the resulting IPv4/IPv6 snapshot across routing and TUN settings, and removes stale exclusions for disabled or removed nodes. DNS lookups use bounded concurrency and timeouts; an unreachable node domain does not prevent configuration generation.
- **Cached FakeIP handling:** Node ICMP traffic with an older FakeIP mapping is resolved to a real address before direct forwarding.

## Notes

- Regenerate and apply your configuration after upgrading to activate these routing changes. Clients with cached FakeIP answers may also need to refresh their DNS cache before measuring the real node ping path.
- This release does not globally bypass ICMP. Device-specific policies remain in control of their traffic.
- Available packages: OpenWrt x86_64 and aarch64_generic IPKs, plus standalone Linux amd64 and arm64 binaries.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ackwrap/ackrun/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5
